question: What were Applied Materials' trailing-twelve-month net revenues as of the end of fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended July 26, 2026)? Build it from filed figures and answer in USD millions.
grading: ±0.5% of 30,837, USD millions (accept $30.8B). The TTM window is 2025-07-28 to 2026-07-26. Equivalent routes: FY2025 + 9M FY2026 - 9M FY2025, or Q4 FY2025 + Q1 + Q2 + Q3 FY2026 (6,800 + 7,012 + 7,910 + 9,115).
answer: TTM net revenue for the four quarters ended July 26, 2026 was USD 30,837 million = FY2025 net revenue 28,368 + nine months FY2026 24,037 - nine months FY2025 21,568. Quarter-by-quarter: Q4 FY2025 6,800 (28,368 - 21,568) + Q1 FY2026 7,012 + Q2 FY2026 7,910 + Q3 FY2026 9,115 = 30,837. [T08-E1, T08-E2]
